terms.comment: lībum, a cheese cake, was the Roman birthday offering. Cato’s recipe: lībum hōc modō facitō (Agr. 75).

phrases.english: Grandma is baking you a birthday cake.

phrases.latin: ūna celebrāta est per duo lība diēs
phrases.english: one day was celebrated with two birthday cakes (Ovid’s birthday, shared with his brother)
